descriptor.retrieval_description: Black foamed polymer tubular object with a textured, dry, porous lateral surface and a concave cylindrical contour. The intended contact region is smooth yet textured with continuous curvature and no visible seams.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral sidewall surfaces in the centered grasp band
descriptor.local_geometry: Concave cylindrical curvature forming an hourglass-like profile with a central axial through-hole
descriptor.uncertainty: The internal composition of the foam core is not visible, only the outer textured surface layer.
